content.short: Salus provides blockchain security services for Web3 projects.
content.description: Salus specializes in blockchain security, delivering services for Web3 projects such as expert smart contract audits and comprehensive Web3 penetration testing. It applies ZK-SNARKs in Solidity through ZK transform and conducts Blockchain Scientific Research to inform its methods. Salus also develops customized blockchain security solutions tailored to each organization. With a commitment to accessibility and trust, Salus helps teams adopt blockchain technology and advance security and innovation across ecosystems.
